ci_supplychain_ack.statement: Narrows stage 2's fail-closed PR-review gate with an all-generated carve-out, derived only from trusted API-read changed paths in default-branch stage-2 code (never stage-1's contributor-editable artifact -- the FR-01.17 (E)7 self-exemption boundary is unchanged). A sensitive path anywhere in the diff, a waiver-consumption failure, or the review step actually running and failing all still block; PR Review keeps exactly one producer.
